note: CLI stdout truncation lost the opening half of the JSON for the v3 NR seed call. Recovered groups via regex extraction from the captured tail. node_decisions are NOT recovered — Pass-2 re-derives them against full 2,095 NR residuals. The N=33 group taxonomy below is the durable artifact for Pass-2.

groups.name: RL training mechanism: priority and learning-progress sampling from replay buffers
groups.description: Causal-lever class: re-weight or prioritize replay samples by a learning signal (TD error, learning progress, optimizer-rollout ratio) to focus updates on highest-value transitions.

groups.name: RL training mechanism: action-space augmentation with pretrained primitives
groups.description: Causal-lever class: extend the agent's action set with macros from pretrained policies or task-phase predictors, biasing exploitation toward known skills and enabling multi-stage execution.

groups.name: RL exploration mechanism: human and structural priors to bound search
groups.description: Causal-lever class: shrink the effective exploration space by injecting human attention scaffolding or structural multi-armed-bandit priors over candidate descriptors.

groups.name: RL training data efficiency mechanism: reset reduction and sample reuse
groups.description: Causal-lever class: reduce per-episode human/data overhead via off-policy reuse, reset minimization, or removing auxiliary representation-learning costs.

groups.name: Imitation learning mechanism: similarity-based reward shaping and trajectory augmentation
groups.description: Causal-lever class: shape imitation/preference learning signals via embedding-similarity rewards or label-preserving trajectory augmentation (temporal cropping).

groups.name: Interpretability mechanism: representational decomposition and feature attribution
groups.description: Causal-lever class: decompose model behavior into interpretable components — training-data attribution, filter-concept alignment with reference labels, singular-vector ablation, and analysis of distributed/circuit-level structure.

groups.name: Formal-methods mechanism: proof assistants, model checking, and constraint solvers
groups.description: Causal-lever class: machine-checkable correctness via dependent-type proof assistants, automated model checking of state machines, and ASP/constraint-solver-based design optimization.

groups.name: Output-shaping mechanism: explicit templates, role hierarchy, and structured response formats
groups.description: Causal-lever class: shape generation by injecting structural priors into the prompt or output — instruction-priority hierarchies, role tags, syntactic templates, citation syntax, and JSON schemas — so undesired continuations become improbable.

groups.name: Access/release-governance mechanism: licensing, output filtering, and tool-sandboxing
groups.description: Causal-lever class: gate access to AI artifacts (weights, knowledge graphs, tool calls, outputs) via licenses, permission layers, sandboxed tool emulation, or post-hoc safety filters.

groups.name: Institutional-oversight mechanism: power-distribution governance and disclosure channels
groups.description: Causal-lever class: institutional checks-and-balances against power concentration — distribute oversight across actors and codify confidential whistleblower channels.

groups.name: Forecasting and evaluation mechanism: standardized definitions, dashboards, and ensemble aggregation
groups.description: Causal-lever class: structured estimation under uncertainty — standardized definitions, alternative uncertainty metrics, daily aggregation/feedback dashboards, randomized stress testing, and ensemble-of-judges aggregation.

groups.name: Programme-design mechanism: stipend-conditioning, incentives, and curriculum diversity
groups.description: Causal-lever class: design educational/research programmes via conditional stipends, mentor-pipeline autonomy, and curated curriculum diversity to recruit, retain, and broaden participants.

groups.name: Detection mechanism: holdout-asymmetry anomaly detection and trust-score gating
groups.description: Causal-lever class: detect anomalies via planner asymmetry to held-out signals (sensors not in objective) or low-trust prediction routing to human review.

groups.name: Civil-resilience mechanism: pre-AI infrastructure and emergency-control isolation
groups.description: Causal-lever class: maintain pre-AI infrastructure resilience via local manual control of utilities and emergency mechanisms to disconnect compromised digital systems.

groups.name: Macro-policy mechanism: redistributive taxation and infrastructure-transition incentives
groups.description: Causal-lever class: macro-economic policy levers — progressive taxation funding global health and renewable-infrastructure transition financing — to steer aggregate societal outcomes.

groups.name: Compute and corpus-substrate mechanism: hardware accelerators, compression, and corpus curation
groups.description: Causal-lever class: provide compute and data substrate — programmable accelerators with reconfigurable routing, weight-clustering compression, and domain-specialized corpus curation.

groups.name: Historical case-study mechanism: governance precedents and microeconomic experiments
groups.description: Causal-lever class: cite historical governance/diffusion precedents (treaties, espionage transfer, military deployments) and natural microeconomic experiments as evidence base for AI governance proposals.

groups.name: Adoption-traction validation mechanism: citations, funding, and ecosystem uptake
groups.description: Causal-lever class: validate via observed ecosystem uptake — citations, philanthropic funding, organizational growth — as proxy for usefulness/impact.

groups.name: Authenticity-provenance and symbolic-anchoring mechanism: signatures, certificates, and template mappings
groups.description: Causal-lever class: low-cost authenticity/provenance verification via automated certificate authorities, statistical/steganographic watermarks, and template-based perception-to-symbol mappings.

groups.name: Survey-evaluation mechanism: structured human-report collection for program assessment
groups.description: Causal-lever class: collect structured human reports via surveys, online forms, or preference questions and analyze the aggregate to evaluate programme/system reception.

groups.name: Multi-agent coordination mechanism: communication and joint-action decomposition
groups.description: Causal-lever class: coordinate multi-agent systems via Stackelberg/POSG decomposition, joint-action dynamic programming under shared state, robustness-triggered communication, and natural-language belief reconciliation.

groups.name: Benchmark-design mechanism: controlled conditions, noise ceilings, and standardized frameworks
groups.description: Causal-lever class: design controlled benchmarks — saliency baselines, noise-ceiling RDMs, propensity-matched A/B tests, and shared SSL evaluation frameworks — for fair AI evaluation.

groups.name: On-device deployment-validation mechanism: edge hardware and embedded inference
groups.description: Causal-lever class: validate models on resource-constrained on-device hardware (quadcopter, Arduino) to demonstrate practical edge-deployment feasibility.

groups.name: Probabilistic-inference mechanism: MCMC, sample-based estimation, and latent-variable identification
groups.description: Causal-lever class: probabilistic inference under intractable likelihoods — involutive MCMC, importance-sampled partition functions, deconfounders for unobserved confounders, and anchor-variable latent measurement.

groups.name: Generative-model mechanism: invertible flow-based exact-likelihood architectures
groups.description: Causal-lever class: invertible/normalizing-flow generative architectures providing exact log-likelihood for forecasting and probabilistic generation.

groups.name: Long-horizon capability-projection mechanism: quantitative forecast modeling
groups.description: Causal-lever class: extrapolate long-horizon trajectories (AI progress, catastrophe rates) via parametric forecast curves and observer-bias-free physical anchors.

groups.name: Whole-brain emulation mechanism: substrate-level proof-of-concept
groups.description: Causal-lever class: substrate-level whole-brain emulation as proof-of-concept — start with simple organisms and tissue-handling pipelines to establish end-to-end emulation precedent.

groups.name: Resource-leveraging mechanism: re-purposing and open-sourcing existing models
groups.description: Causal-lever class: re-purpose existing or open-sourced models to expand access, reduce time-to-market, and lower deployment cost in new application domains.

groups.name: Online map/memory-update mechanism: consistency-driven node addition
groups.description: Causal-lever class: maintain online maps/memories by adding nodes only when perceptual or two-way consistency checks fail, preserving prior layout knowledge during exploration.

groups.name: Algorithmic-identification mechanism: search-based discovery of model components
groups.description: Causal-lever class: offline algorithmic discovery of structural components — binary search over breakpoint probabilities, observation-vs-plan diff for changed action descriptors.

groups.name: Biosurveillance mechanism: distributed sensing and rapid diagnostics
groups.description: Causal-lever class: distributed sensing of public-health signals via point-of-care isothermal diagnostics, smartphone-integrated wearables, and identification of high-mixing transmission loci.

groups.name: Question/goal decomposition mechanism: extraction and disambiguation under ambiguity
groups.description: Causal-lever class: decompose complex queries/goals into simpler sub-questions or extracted clauses, with disambiguation when multiple goal extrapolations are plausible.

groups.name: Currency-design mechanism: token issuance and donation-flow modeling
groups.description: Causal-lever class: design currency systems for community/funding flows — fiat-token issuance, donation channels — and account for valuation volatility in revenue planning.

parsed.notes: Input distribution skewed toward im/dr/va; ~20% folded to existing HDBSCAN clusters at sim≥0.70, ~5% (8 nodes) marked residual due to genuinely idiosyncratic substrate (habituation psychology, OpenAI-Five surgeries, Atari corpus). Granularity targets ABSTRACT MECHANISM CLASS: e.g. RL training is split into 6 lever-classes (constraint, model-based, replay-priority, action-augmentation, exploration-prior, data-efficiency) rather than one umbrella; output-shaping merges template/instruction/role/JSON families because they share the same lever (structural priors on generation).
